hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"codebase-memory-mcp: prefer search_graph / trace_path / query_graph over broad grep for architecture questions. Re-index after structural changes. graphify is retired in this repo."}}' ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'node_modules' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"codebase-memory-mcp: for architecture/navigation questions use search_graph or trace_path before reading many source files. graphify is retired do not use graphify-out/."}}'; fi || true
